newsitem.title: USA: Koll Real Estate offers debt exchange.
newsitem.headline: Koll Real Estate offers debt exchange.

text.p: Koll Real Estate Group Inc said it had reached an agreement with representatives of a number of holders of its 12-percent senior-subordinated and subordinated pay-in-kind debentures due 2002.
It said in a statement the agreement would de-leverage its capital structure through a voluntary exchange of about $194 million face amount of debt for equity.
Senior-subordinated holders will receive about 4,525 shares for each $1,000 principal amount currently outstanding, it said.
The company said subordinated holders will receive about 2,262 shares for each $1,000 principal amount currently outstanding.

A 100-percent acceptance rate for the exchange offer would result in 90 percent of the company's equity, in the form of newly-issued shares of common stock, being held by the debenture holders, it said.
The remaining 10 percent of the company's equity would be owned by current preferred and common stockholders, it added.
Koll Real Estate Group provides commercial and residential real estate development services on a national and international basis.
